import pandas as pd, numpy as np
p='single_cell_dynamics_question.csv'
df=pd.read_csv(p)
d2=((df[['enh_x','enh_y','enh_z']].values - df[['prom_x','prom_y','prom_z']].values)**2).sum(axis=1)
df['dist']=np.sqrt(d2); df['contact']=(df.dist<=260).astype(int)
# group sorted
g=df.groupby('cell_id')[['contact','transcription','dist']]
C=g['contact'].apply(lambda s:s.values).to_numpy()  # list? Actually series of arrays
T=g['transcription'].apply(lambda s:s.values).to_numpy()
# easier collect arrays
C_list=[a for a in C]
T_list=[a for a in T]
C=np.array(C_list); T=np.array(T_list)
print(C.shape)
def lag_prob(x,y,lags):
    # x at t, y at t+k? We'll define P(Y_t=1 | X_{t-k}=1) vs baseline
    for k in lags:
        if k==0:
            xprev=x[:,:]; ycur=y[:,:]
        elif k>0:
            xprev=x[:,:-k]; ycur=y[:,k:]
        else:
            # k negative: y current? We'll handle outside
            continue
        mask1=xprev==1; mask0=xprev==0
        p1=ycur[mask1].mean(); p0=ycur[mask0].mean(); n1=mask1.sum(); n0=mask0.sum()
        rr=p1/p0 if p0>0 else np.nan
        print(f'lag {k}: n1={n1} P(Y|Xprev=1)={p1:.4f} n0={n0} P(Y|Xprev=0)={p0:.4f} RR={rr:.3f}')
print('X=contact, Y=transcription at later time (C->T)')
lag_prob(C,T,range(0,11))
print('X=transcription, Y=contact at later time (T->C)')
lag_prob(T,C,range(0,11))
# negative lags for C->T: contact after transcription
print('C->T negative lags: P(C_t=1 | T_{t-k}=1) equivalent T->C above? actually C target, T predictor')
def lag_prob2(pred,target,lags):
    for k in lags:
        if k>0:
            xprev=pred[:,:-k]; ycur=target[:,k:]
        elif k<0:
            kk=-k
            xprev=pred[:,kk:]; ycur=target[:,:-kk]
        else:
            xprev=pred[:,:]; ycur=target[:,:]
        mask1=xprev==1; mask0=xprev==0
        p1=ycur[mask1].mean(); p0=ycur[mask0].mean()
        print(f'lag {k}: n1={mask1.sum()} P(target|pred=1)={p1:.4f} P(target|pred=0)={p0:.4f} RR={p1/p0:.3f}')
print('\\npred=contact target=transcription, positive lag = transcription after contact')
lag_prob2(C,T,range(-10,11))
print('\\npred=transcription target=contact, positive lag = contact after transcription')
lag_prob2(T,C,range(-10,11))
PY"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
p='single_cell_dynamics_question.csv'
df=pd.read_csv(p)
D2=((df[['enh_x','enh_y','enh_z']].values - df[['prom_x','prom_y','prom_z']].values)**2).sum(axis=1)
df['dist']=np.sqrt(D2); df['contact']=(df.dist<=260).astype(int)
T=np.stack([s.values for _,s in df.groupby('cell_id')['transcription']])
C=np.stack([s.values for _,s in df.groupby('cell_id')['contact']])
def ac(x,maxlag):
    # mean per lag across cells weighted? simple pooled
    for k in range(maxlag+1):
        a=x[:,:-k].ravel(); b=x[:,k:].ravel()
        print(k, np.corrcoef(a,b)[0,1], 'P both', np.mean(a*b), 'P x_t=1|x_prev=1', b[a==1].mean(), 'base',b.mean())
print('T autocorr')
ac(T,5)
print('C autocorr')
ac(C,5)
# partial: P(C_t|C_{t-1}, T_{t-1}); P(T_t|T_{t-1}, C_{t-1})
# Flatten lag variables
for v in ['T']:
    x=T; y=C
    X=x[:,1:].ravel(); Yprev=y[:,:-1].ravel(); Xprev=x[:,:-1].ravel()
    print('P(T_t=1 | T_{t-1}, C_{t-1})')
    import pandas as pd2
    d=pd2.DataFrame({'T':X,'Tprev':Xprev,'Cprev':Yprev})
    print(d.groupby(['Tprev','Cprev'])['T'].mean().unstack())
    print('counts',d.groupby(['Tprev','Cprev']).size().unstack())
    # P(C_t=1 | C_{t-1}, T_{t-1})
    Y=y[:,1:].ravel(); Yprev2=y[:,:-1].ravel(); Tprev=x[:,:-1].ravel()
    d2=pd2.DataFrame({'C':Y,'Cprev':Yprev2,'Tprev':Tprev})
    print('P(C_t=1 | C_{t-1}, T_{t-1})')
    print(d2.groupby(['Tprev','Cprev'])['C'].mean().unstack())
    print(d2.groupby(['Tprev','Cprev']).size().unstack())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.api as sm
p='single_cell_dynamics_question.csv'
df=pd.read_csv(p)
D2=((df[['enh_x','enh_y','enh_z']].values - df[['prom_x','prom_y','prom_z']].values)**2).sum(axis=1)
df['dist']=np.sqrt(D2); df['contact']=(df.dist<=260).astype(int)
T=np.stack([s.values for _,s in df.groupby('cell_id')['transcription']])
C=np.stack([s.values for _,s in df.groupby('cell_id')['contact']])
# Predict T_t using T_{t-1}, C_{t-1}, T_{t-2}, C_{t-2}, maybe T_{t-3}, C_{t-3}
def make_data(target, lags=3):
    Y=target[:,lags:].ravel()
    cols=[]
    names=[]
    for lag in range(1,lags+1):
        cols.append(T[:,lags-lag:-lag].ravel() if lag<lags else T[:,:-lags].ravel() if lags==lag else None)
    # Simpler: use loop
    arrays=[]; names=[]
    for lag in range(1,lags+1):
        arrays.append(T[:,lags-lag:T.shape[1]-lag].ravel()); names.append(f'T_lag{lag}')
        arrays.append(C[:,lags-lag:C.shape[1]-lag].ravel()); names.append(f'C_lag{lag}')
    X=np.column_stack(arrays)
    X=sm.add_constant(X)
    return Y,X,names
for target,label in [(T,'T'),(C,'C')]:
    Y,X,names=make_data(target,3)
    model=sm.Logit(Y,X).fit(disp=0)
    print('\\nPredicting',label,'t from lags 1-3')
    print(pd.DataFrame({'var':['const']+names,'coef':model.params,'p':model.pvalues}).to_string(index=False))
    print('Pseudo R2',model.prsquared)
